stock.description: Altus Holdings Limited specializes in offering corporate financial solutions and real estate investment management across Hong Kong and Japan. Its operations are primarily categorized into two divisions: Advisory and Consulting, and Property Investment. Within its corporate finance arm, the firm delivers a broad spectrum of services, including underwriting, strategic financial advice, regulatory compliance guidance, capital market consulting for equity, and various other specialized consulting engagements. Additionally, the company manages a portfolio of investment properties, renting them out for both residential and commercial purposes, maintains a collection of financial securities, and furnishes administrative support services. Established in 2000, Altus Holdings is based in Central, Hong Kong, and operates as a subsidiary of Kinley-Hecico Holdings Limited.
